verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ROS 2 has a broad ecosystem of reusable components. The project describes itself as libraries and tools 'from drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms', and users confirm 'a lot of nodes and drivers out there' plus ecosystem-provided teleop, sim, bagging and shared datatypes. However, the pack never documents a package registry or the workflow for pulling third-party packages; the only install evidence is the Debian install variants with bundled message packages. Users also report dependency hell and some components being hobbyist-maintained or abandoned. Missing for 10: first-party docs on a package index or registry and dependency-resolution workflow, explicit evidence of hardware driver packages being installed, and hands-on corroboration of pulling packages for common hardware and behaviors.
